answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than indefinite accumulation. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly created vertex has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify an isolated sybil cluster without links to established peers. Like a falcon crossing a dune, an identity cannot leap this gap: its negligible score leaves it unable to meet consensus thresholds.
